contentSummary: This is the unit page for Sachdeva Steel Products (Ship Breakers) LLP, one of Sachdeva Group's two Alang yards. It carries only three things: a short origin paragraph (Alang activity since 1983, this unit trading under the SSP name since 1994, 36 ships recycled to date) beside a yard photo with a "32 Years of Excellence" badge; a yard contact card overlaid on a container image (Plot No 65, Alang Ship Breaking Yard, Bhavnagar, Gujarat; +91 278 2429573; info@sachdevagroup.in); and a 36-row "List of Ships Recycled" table with SR No / Name / Type / LDT MT / Year. The table is the real substance of the page — 36 vessels spanning 1994-95 to 2019-20 totalling 276,570.51 LDT across 15 vessel types…

blocks.summary: EMPTY BANNER. <section class="page-title5 theme-before"> contains no markup at all — no H1, no breadcrumb, no title. Net result: a 400px tall decorative strip of gradient-washed photo with zero content and no page…

MISSING DESIGN LAYER: sspsb.html does not load css/marine.css or js/marine.js. index.html loads both (index.html lines 78 and 891). This page is still entirely on the legacy bootstrap/style.css stack.
BRAND FONT NOT LOADED: the head loads Aldrich, Signika Negative and Rubik from Google Fonts, but never loads Oswald — the brand font the whole marine.css system is built on.
LEGACY TABLE ATTRIBUTES: line 215, <table class="mb-10" width="100%" border="1" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="5"> — HTML4 presentational attributes duplicating what CSS already does.
POINTLESS WRAPPERS: lines 156-158 and 191-193 wrap a single with no children — no art direction, no format fallback, just noise.
